description.value: Canadian Pizza Plus is a Burnaby restaurant blending two distinct cuisines — classic Canadian-style pizza (customizable with up to five toppings, or as gourmet fusion pies like Butter Chicken Pizza) alongside a full authentic Indian menu of curries, biryanis, and tandoori wraps. The hybrid concept makes it a practical stop for a hungry cycling group with varied tastes. Online ordering supports both pickup and delivery.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and functional, showing a full menu for pickup and delivery with both Indian food and pizza. The website address (8650 Cinnamon Drive #34, Burnaby, BC V5A4H7) and phone (+1 604-420-0008) match OSM, but the OSM community is tagged as 'North Vancouver' while the business is clearly in Burnaby — coordinates (49.264, -122.914) also place it in Burnaby. The menu explicitly labels vegetarian items and includes an extensive vegetarian Indian food section; pickup ordering is confirmed via the online ordering system.
concerns: OSM community tag says 'North Vancouver' but the website address and coordinates place the business in Burnaby — the OSM community attribution appears incorrect.
OSM addr tags only contain 'addr:unit: 34' with no street or city; full address sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with a functional website and online ordering. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a hot meal with broad menu options.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu has a dedicated 'Authentic Indian Food - Vegetarian' section (Shahi Paneer, Channa Masala, Palak Paneer, etc.) and menu legend labels vegetarian items. Multiple vegetarian wraps, samosas, and pakoras also listed

wow_evidence: blending two distinct cuisines — classic Canadian-style pizza... alongside a full authentic Indian menu
